src/EventSubscriber/PerformanceMetricsSu.message: Property 'dataCollector' of PerformanceMetricsSubscriber is mutated but not reset in reset().
src/EventSubscriber/PerformanceMetricsSu.reason: False positive (2026-11-11 igor triage): the readonly collector only holds the current request's metrics; onKernelRequest() resets it at the start of every main request (FrankenPHP worker, no services resetter) and reset() calls $this->dataCollector->reset(). igor-php counts set*() calls on an injected service as mutations and only accepts a property assignment inside reset(), which a readonly property cannot have; @igor-ignore does not silence this rule.
